locations.note: Emile and Freddie cross the trenches of the Flanders front at Ypres under the first gas attacks.
Emile and Freddie storm Fort Douaumont, where Von Dorf is hiding, capture his new tank and rescue Anna's father.
The heroes are thrown into the shell-torn no man's land of the 1916 Somme offensive.
Karl escapes his prison camp to reach the family farm in occupied Saint-Mihiel, gives Marie his gas mask when the farm is gassed, and is saved by Anna.
Emile is thrown into the doomed Nivelle offensive, kills his reckless commander with a shovel, and is court-martialled and shot.
The bombarded city of Reims and its burning cathedral form one of the game's early stops.

routes.name: Emile and Freddie
routes.note: Emile and Freddie chase Baron von Dorf's zeppelin from Ypres to Reims, storm Fort Douaumont at Verdun, and Freddie finally corners the Baron on the Somme; Emile's war ends in the Nivelle offensive on the Chemin des Dames.

routes.name: Karl
routes.note: Karl survives the zeppelin crash at Reims and is taken prisoner, then escapes to his family's farm at Saint-Mihiel.
